questions.questionText: [Soal MTK SMA 1] Jika fungsi kuadrat f(x) = x^2 - 6x + 8 memiliki titik puncak di (p, q), maka nilai dari p + q adalah...
[Soal MTK SMA 2] Nilai limit x mendekati 2 dari (x^2 - 4) / (x - 2) adalah...
questions.explanation: Faktorkan pembilang: (x - 2)(x + 2) / (x - 2) = x + 2. Untuk x -> 2, nilai limit = 2 + 2 = 4.

questions.questionText: [Soal B.Indo SMA 1] Karakteristik utama dari teks editorial dalam media massa cetak atau daring adalah...
questions.optionA: Memuat opini resmi redaksi terhadap isu faktual yang hangat diperbincangkan publik
questions.optionB: Hanya memuat data statistik tanpa ada opini pengarang
questions.optionD: Berisi dialog fiktif antar tokoh imajiner
questions.optionE: Ditulis oleh pembaca umum di kolom surat pembaca

questions.questionText: [Soal B.Inggris SMA 1] Choose the correct sentence in Third Conditional form:
questions.optionA: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.optionB: If I knew her number, I would call her right away.
questions.optionC: If they had studied harder, they would have passed the final scholarship exam.
questions.optionD: If you heat ice, it melts automatically.
questions.optionE: If she comes, we go to cinema together.
questions.explanation: Third Conditional pattern is: If + past perfect (had studied), would have + V3 (would have passed) to express unreal situations in the past.

questions.questionText: [Soal B.Inggris SMA 2] The passive voice of 'The government built three hundred new schools last year' is...
questions.optionA: Three hundred new schools are built by the government last year.
questions.optionB: Three hundred new schools were built by the government last year.
questions.optionC: Three hundred new schools have been built by the government.
questions.optionD: Three hundred new schools had built by the government last year.
questions.optionE: Three hundred new schools were being built by the government.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive is formed by: was/were + past participle (V3). Since 'schools' is plural, we use 'were built'.

questions.optionB: Three hundred new schools were built by the government last year.
questions.optionC: Three hundred new schools have been built by the government.
questions.optionD: Three hundred new schools had built by the government last year.
questions.optionE: Three hundred new schools were being built by the government.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive is formed by: was/were + past participle (V3). Since 'schools' is plural, we use 'were built'.

questions.questionText: [Soal B.Inggris SMA 13] Choose the correct sentence in Third Conditional form:
questions.optionA: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
questions.optionB: If I knew her number, I would call her right away.
questions.optionC: If they had studied harder, they would have passed the final scholarship exam.
questions.optionD: If you heat ice, it melts automatically.
questions.optionE: If she comes, we go to cinema together.
questions.explanation: Third Conditional pattern is: If + past perfect (had studied), would have + V3 (would have passed) to express unreal situations in the past.

questions.questionText: [Soal Sains & Soshum 1] Sebuah benda bermassa 2 kg dilepas tanpa kecepatan awal dari ketinggian 20 m. Jika g = 10 m/s^2, kecepatan benda saat menyentuh tanah adalah...
questions.explanation: Rumus gerak jatuh bebas: v = sqrt(2gh) = sqrt(2 * 10 * 20) = sqrt(400) = 20 m/s.

questions.questionText: [Soal Sains & Soshum 2] Partikel subatomik penyusun atom yang bermuatan negatif dan mengelilingi inti atom adalah...
questions.explanation: Elektron bermuatan listrik negatif dan bergerak pada orbital di luar inti atom, sedangkan proton dan neutron berada di dalam inti.

questions.questionText: [Soal Sains & Soshum 3] Dalam biologi sel, organel yang berfungsi sebagai 'pabrik energi' sel melalui respirasi aerobik menghasilkan ATP adalah...
questions.explanation: Mitokondria merupakan tempat berlangsungnya siklus Krebs dan rantai transpor elektron yang memproduksi sebagian besar molekul ATP sel.

questions.questionText: [Soal Sains & Soshum 4] Kebijakan bank sentral menaikkan tingkat suku bunga acuan (BI Rate) untuk meredam laju inflasi termasuk dalam instrumen kebijakan...
questions.explanation: Menaikkan suku bunga untuk mengurangi jumlah uang beredar dan menekan inflasi disebut kebijakan moneter kontraktif (tight money policy).
